chunks: "Why are you surprised at the command of God? God's mercy and blessings be upon you, O members of this household," they said. "Verily He is worthy of praise and glory."
ai.seo_question: What did the angels say to Maryam regarding God's command and her status?
ai.summary: In this verse, the angels address Maryam, reassuring her against astonishment at the divine decree by invoking God's mercy and blessings upon the 'Ahl al-Bayt.' Shia scholars often cite this as a key proof for Maryam's inclusion in the exclusive title of Ahl al-Bayt, distinct from the Prophet's household, highlighting her spiritual purity and status. The phrase 'Hamid Majid' underscores the divine attributes of praise and glory associated with this bestowal of grace.
